artifact_severity_scale_note: 1 means low or no artifact; 5 means severe artifact.

ratings.compared_to_elevenlabs: The voice was different from the ElevenLabs voice, and ElevenLabs felt more natural mainly because the voice ID was different. Ultravox could be better with another voice. A fair comparison needs voice selection/voice ID alignment.
ratings.notes: Ultravox audio was intelligible with no understanding problems. Voice quality was strong. Naturalness and sales tone were acceptable but likely limited by the selected voice. Pacing was good. Turn-taking cannot be strongly judged from this one output. Overall it is promising enough for thesis/demo and product-fallback exploration, but latency still needs a warm-turn benchmark.
